title: Explain what value-type and reference-type assignment copy, including shared reference fields

rubric.point: `p.Tracks[0]` is "live": `p` and `q` refer to the same `Playlist` object, so replacing its `Tracks` field through `q` is seen through `p`, and the element change then applies to that new array.
`saved[0]` is "intro": `saved` holds a reference to the original array, which was never modified; replacing the field only repointed the object's field.

questions.model:
`p.Tracks[0]` is **"live"**, `saved[0]` is **"intro"**.

Optional explanation: `var q = p` copies the object reference, so there is one `Playlist`. Assigning `q.Tracks` replaces that shared object's field, so `p.Tracks` now points to the new array too. `saved` copied the reference to the first array, which nothing changed.
